# couchbase-capella_replication_activation_status (Resource)

This resource allows you to pause or resume an XDCR replication. Destroying this resource does not change the replication.

Pause and resume change one direction only. For a `twoWay` replication, use one resource for each direction: the replication `id` with the source cluster ID, and the `reverse_replication_id` with the target cluster ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pauses the replication. Set state = "running" to resume it.
resource "couchbase-capella_replication_activation_status" "new_replication_activation_status" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  replication_id  = "<replication_id>"
  state           = "paused"
}

# Pause and resume change one direction only. For a twoWay replication, the reverse direction
# needs its own resource, with the target cluster ID and the reverse_replication_id of the replication.
resource "couchbase-capella_replication_activation_status" "reverse_replication_activation_status" {
  organization_id = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  project_id      = "ffffffff-aaaa-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  cluster_id      = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-1414-eeee-000000000000"
  replication_id  = "<reverse_replication_id>"
  state           = "paused"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.
- `replication_id` (String) The ID of the replication.
- `state` (String) - The requested status: `running` or `paused`. A replication that is starting shows as `running`, and one that is pausing shows as `paused`. A `failed` replication shows as a change, and the next apply sends the request again.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_replication_activation_status.new_replication_activation_status replication_id=<replication_id>,cluster_id=<cluster_id>,project_id=<project_id>,organization_id=<organization_id>
```
